nodes.title: LOAD FROM DIRECTORY INFO 💡
widgets_values:
##                     LOAD FROM DIRECTORY
>  
> Set path to your folder that contains the images to load in "directory"  
>  
> Leave Random INDEX minimum at 0 
>  
> Set Random INDEX maximum at the same nr as the numer of images in your load directory minus (-) image_load_cap  
>  
> Set image_load_cap to the number of images you want your initial collage to have (from 1-100 images) 
>  
> If you have issues with loading the images, select all images in the load folder using alt+a and then press F2 and change the names to something like "1". All images with change name to 1(1).png, 1(2).png, 1(3).png etc

nodes.title: TEACACHE & SAGEATTENTION
widgets_values:
###     TeaCache & SageAttention
>  
>  
>  
For instructions on how to install TeaCache & SageAttention on Windows please visit  
  
### [Guide: Install Triton, Sageattention And TeaCache On Windows](https://www.zanno.se/triton-sageattention-and-teacache/)   
>  
>  
>

Be creative in style and background based on the input image. Make sure that when the input images has humans in it, their face and eyes should be very detailed and high quality. Start the prompts with the triggerwords "aidmafluxproultra". 

Treat input images as one single image, even if it's more than one.

nodes.title: REDUX IMAGE INFO
widgets_values:
#             REDUX IMAGE  
  
The image you load here will be used to enforce the styles of the resulting images. I suggest a redux strength between medium and high in the "Style Model Apply Simple" node. Highest strength tend to overtake the generated image, and lesser than medium will not give enough of the wanted style.
